# Applied Mathematics III

> CSC301, a core subject of Semester III in the B.E. Computer Engineering
> curriculum at the University of Mumbai, studied at Terna Engineering College.
> This repository holds the reference books, university question papers, solved
> papers, personal preparation notes and the syllabus kept from that course.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
Co-author: Mega Satish, ORCID 0000-0002-1844-9557
Institution: Terna Engineering College, University of Mumbai
Programme: B.E. Computer Engineering, Second Year, Semester III
Course code: CSC301
Licence: CC BY 4.0, attribution required
First released: 17 January 2020

## What is in this repository

- Reference Books, 13 files covering the five topic areas
- Question Papers, 8 files, split into previous papers and solved papers
- My Preparation, 5 files of personal notes
- SE-Comps_CBCGS_Syllabus.pdf, the University of Mumbai CBCGS syllabus
- Blueprint (AM-III).png, the paper pattern and marks distribution

## What the course covers

Complex variables, including analytic functions, the Cauchy-Riemann equations,
contour integration and residue theory. Laplace transforms. Fourier transforms.
Z-transforms. Statistical methods, including probability distributions,
sampling theory and hypothesis testing.
